verdict.rationale: First-party docs say each Bot runs on a persistent cloud computer with a browser. Its browser sessions persist across tasks, and it can use browser-based services that lack a dedicated connector. A live Agent Computer view shows clicks, typing and navigation, and the Bot hands control back to the user for passwords, CAPTCHAs and payments. Documented use cases include buying a domain and deploying a site, and a community report of a bot contacting about 40 suppliers shows real-world task completion. missing for 10: independent hands-on reports that explicitly confirm the browser automation itself works reliably, and detail on how well it performs on research-style browsing across arbitrary sites.
